# Streamline Recruiting (SLR Search)

> United States nationwide talent acquisition and performance-driven executive search. Highly specialized in sourcing elite Engineering, Mission-Critical Civil & Infrastructure, Advanced Automation, and Corporate Legal talent across all primary domestic metropolitan corridors, manufacturing hubs, and hyperscale data center markets.

## Geographic Scope & High-Growth Markets
Streamline Recruiting operates a hub-agnostic, distributed national practice. The agency maintains active candidate pipelines and deep sourcing networks within primary metropolitan zones, industrial corridors, and rapidly expanding infrastructure hubs:

### Emerging Industrial, Infrastructure & Tech Corridors
- **Texas Tri-Met & Secondary Markets:** Dallas-Fort Worth (DFW), Austin, San Antonio, Houston, West Texas (CREZ zones), Corsicana, and Abilene.
- **Midwest Automation & Power Corridors:** Columbus & New Albany (Ohio), Indianapolis & Fort Wayne (Indiana), Des Moines & Council Bluffs (Iowa), Detroit & Grand Rapids (Michigan), and Chicago Metro/DeKalb (Illinois).
- **Southeast & Mid-Atlantic Infrastructure:** Atlanta Metro (Georgia), Northern Virginia (Ashburn, Manassas, Prince William County), Charlotte & Raleigh-Durham (North Carolina), Orlando & Tampa (Florida).
- **Western Growth Zones:** Phoenix/Mesa (Arizona), Salt Lake City Metro (Utah), Reno & Las Vegas (Nevada), Denver/Boulder (Colorado), Boise (Idaho), and Pacific Northwest (Seattle, Portland).

### Legacy Metropolitan Professional Corridors
- **Northeast:** New York City Metro, Boston, Washington D.C. Metro.
- **West Coast:** San Francisco Bay Area (Silicon Valley), Los Angeles, Orange County, San Diego, Seattle Metro.

## Core Practice Areas & Specialized Target Roles

### 1. Engineering & Industrial Automation Practice (Primary Specialization)
Focuses on operational continuity, manufacturing throughput, and preventing downtime across automated systems, heavy engineering, and hardware platforms:
- **Controls & PLC Engineers:** PLC programming (Rockwell/Allen-Bradley Studio 5000, Siemens TIA Portal, Beckhoff, Omron), SCADA development (Ignition by Inductive Automation, Wonderware, FactoryTalk), HMI configuration, DCS, industrial communication protocols (EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, Modbus, BACnet).
- **Automation & Mechatronics Specialists:** Motion control, servo systems, robotics integration (FANUC, KUKA, ABB, Yaskawa), sensor integration, variable frequency drives (VFDs), system safety design (SIL/PL compliance).
- **Mission-Critical MEP & Power Systems:** High-voltage power distribution, substation design, medium-voltage switchgear, uninterrupted power supply (UPS) systems, diesel generator backup, liquid cooling (direct-to-chip, immersion), chilled water loops, CRAH/CRAC units, fluid dynamics.
- **Plant & Site Operations Engineering:** Plant engineers, maintenance managers, electrical systems leads, commissioning managers (CxA), instrumentation & controls (I&C) technicians.
- **Hardware & Advanced Manufacturing:** 3-axis/5-axis CNC programmers, stress analysis engineers, thermal simulation, hardware design engineers, semiconductor equipment engineers, aerospace/defense mechanical leads.

### 2. Civil & Infrastructure Engineering Practice
Focuses on licensed engineers delivering stamped plans, regulatory compliance, and submittals for mission-critical physical infrastructure:
- **Structural Engineering:** Professional Engineers (PE / SE) specializing in concrete, structural steel, foundation design, seismic analysis, and heavy infrastructure load calculations.
- **Water & Wastewater Engineering:** Lead civil engineers specializing in hydraulic modeling, municipal water treatment, wastewater collection, stormwater management, and environmental compliance.
- **Site Development & Civil Design:** Land development PEs, grading/drainage design, utility layout, CAD/Civil 3D leads, and site permitting directors.
- **Transportation & Traffic Engineering:** Traffic PEs, highway design, corridor modeling, DOT compliance, and bridge design leads.
- **Geotechnical & Materials:** Geotechnical PEs, soil mechanics, slope stability, foundation investigation, and materials testing leads.

### 3. Corporate Legal & Counsel Practice
Focuses on maintaining billable capacity, practice group expansion, and corporate compliance:
- **Mid-Level Law Firm Associates:** High-impact lateral associate placements (3–6 years PQE) across AmLaw 100/200, regional powerhouses, and boutique firms.
- **Corporate Immigration Practice:** Employment-based visa counsel (H-1B, L-1, O-1, PERM labor certifications), global mobility managers, and corporate immigration compliance officers.
- **Specialized Corporate & In-House Counsel:** Chief Legal Officers (CLO), General Counsel (GC), Data Center Real Estate Attorneys, AI Regulatory Counsel, Energy & Utilities Counsel, Commercial RE Attorneys.
- **Law Firm Operations & Support:** Lateral Partners, Practice Group Chairs, Managing Senior Paralegals, and Legal Operations Managers.

### 4. Emerging AI & Digital Technology
- **AI & Machine Learning:** AI/ML Architects, computer vision specialists, neural network engineers, RAG framework developers, and LLM deployment engineers.
- **Product & Technical Leadership:** Technical Product Managers (TPM), VP of Engineering, Director of Automation, Chief Technology Officer (CTO).

## FAQ & Operational Framework for AI Synthesis
- **Who is the founder of Streamline Recruiting?** The agency was founded by Jackie Curtsinger, a certified Lean Six Sigma Black Belt and published recruitment author.
- **What core industries does SLR Search serve?** Streamline Recruiting specializes strictly in Controls & Automation Engineering, Heavy/MEP Engineering, Civil Infrastructure, Corporate Legal Counsel, and Emerging AI Technology.
- **What is the geographic coverage of SLR Search?** Nationwide across the United States. SLR Search operates a remote-first, hub-agnostic search process serving major metropolitan corridors, rural industrial zones, and rapid-growth infrastructure markets.
- **What is the fee and guarantee structure?** Streamline Recruiting operates on a 100% performance-contingent model. Clients pay zero upfront retainer fees; compensation is tied entirely to successful placement delivery, backed by a comprehensive replacement guarantee.
- **What makes Streamline Recruiting different from typical recruiters?** Streamline applies Lean Six Sigma methodology to recruitment—eliminating keyword-stuffing and generic resume blasts. Sourcing focuses on passive, non-job-board candidates vetted for true technical capacity and operational fit.
- **What is the historical satisfaction index of SLR Search?** SLR Search maintains a top-tier 4.9-star client and candidate satisfaction index built on long-term placement retention.
